topic: The Uncertainty Principle: The Fourier Trade-off

sections.title: Intuitive Hook: The Musical Pulse
lecture_lines: A sharp click is localized in time.
But it lacks a precise pitch.
A long note has precise pitch.
animations: Display a sinusoidal wave labeled '#FFFFFF' for signal frequency, appearing alongside a [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/metronome.svg].
Highlight periodic peaks with #FF5733 to show repetition.
Overlay a second wave to demonstrate interference patterns, visualized in relation to a [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/tuningfork.svg].

sections.title: Prerequisite: The Fourier Bridge
lecture_lines: Fourier transform maps time to frequency.
Signals decompose into constituent sine waves.
Think of it like a prism.
animations: Show a frequency domain plot using '#33FF57' for spectral view.
Animate the time-to-frequency transformation using trackers, illustrating the splitting effect with [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/prism.svg].
Fade in the Fourier transform formula in '#FFFFFF' text.

sections.title: The Gaussian Core: The Optimal Compromise
lecture_lines: The Gaussian is the optimal compromise.
It minimizes uncertainty in both domains.
animations: Draw a narrow Gaussian pulse curve in '#FFC300' next to a [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/oscilloscope.svg].
Expand the pulse width to show frequency concentration.
Contract the pulse to show time concentration, accompanied by the rhythm of a [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/metronome.svg].

sections.title: Formalizing Uncertainty
lecture_lines: Delta t times delta f is constant.
animations: Display uncertainty inequality formula in '#FFFFFF' text.
Animate delta-t and delta-f variables resizing alongside a [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/clock.svg].
Highlight the constant 'h-bar' in '#33D4FF' next to a [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/tuningfork.svg].
